note: A stadium north of J3 empties onto one cross street.
note_ko: J3 북쪽 경기장의 차량이 한꺼번에 교차 도로로 쏟아져 나와요.

scenario.name: special_event
scenario.title: Special event · Stadium lets out
scenario.title_ko: 대형 행사 · 경기 종료 후 퇴장
scenario.description: Evening traffic, then the stadium garage north of J3 empties: about 680 extra veh/h leave onto the one-lane cross street into J3 for half an hour (cars wait in the garage when the street is full). A good controller gives J3's north–south phase more green without starving the arterial.
scenario.question: Can the signals absorb a sudden surge on one cross street, and how far does its queue reach?

controller.name: max_pressure
controller.label: Max-pressure
controller.description: Every 5 s, gives green to the axis with the larger pressure (cars upstream minus cars downstream, from loop detectors). No timing plan needed.
